Ironclads

Ironclads: Admiral and Commander

Game · In development

Ironclads aims to address the gap between age of sail vessels and dreadnoughts.

A real-time naval game in development, bringing academic research to a wider audience through play.

As a game, Ironclads aims for realism—truly historical tiers of command from admiral to turret officer, accurate fleet-level tactics, and believable AI.
